theorems.name: Submission.doragm_radial_cutoff_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Euclid P → ℝ) (A B τ R₀ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < A → 0 < τ → A * τ < R₀ → ν (closedBall y R₀) ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable q ν → (∀ x, ‖q x‖ ≤ B) → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * q x) ν ∧ Integrable (fun x => -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * q x) ν ∧ HasDerivAt (fun σ => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / σ) * q x ∂ν) (∫ x, -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * q x ∂ν) τ
